criteria.requirement: Decline, revoke, refresh and disconnect behave correctly; no merge occurs.
criteria.observed: Actual OAuth state/cookie validation rejects stale and replayed callbacks; decline, token refresh and disconnect execute against an HTTP fixture without merging.
criteria.remaining: Provider-side revocation, refresh and disconnect remain unexecuted against a real account.

criteria.requirement: Unavailable provider capabilities remain visibly unavailable rather than simulated.
criteria.observed: Unknown brains and unsupported account specialists reject execution; missing capability does not silently spend through another provider; catalog registration remains not connected.
criteria.remaining: Visible signed-in browser journeys and every shipped no-key provider still require qualification.

criteria.requirement: Connections report only verified capabilities and preserve errors without leaking tokens.
criteria.observed: A verification response updates only the selected unchanged encrypted configuration; replaced connections retain null readiness, named providers return their own metadata, plaintext fixtures never appear in persistence/readback.
criteria.remaining: Unified connection scopes/sync-state and OAuth account capability inventory are broader than this API-provider repair.

criteria.requirement: Concurrent refresh/revocation and cross-account isolation pass meaningful tests.
criteria.observed: Actual SQLite compare-and-swap rejects pending verification after replace/disconnect/replace-back; simultaneous completions have one winner, per-brain credentials stay isolated.
criteria.remaining: OAuth refresh concurrency, multi-user account ownership and live provider revoke remain separate requirements.

criteria.requirement: Budget exhaustion, cancellation and partial failures stop work predictably.
criteria.observed: Cancelled jobs do not execute, model/retry ceilings reject attempts, expired/exhausted work has bounded recovery while retaining previous candidate and test evidence.
criteria.remaining: Real provider and deeper hierarchical budgets need qualified live execution.

criteria.requirement: Concurrent workers do not duplicate effects or overwrite newer results.
criteria.observed: Concurrent claim/admission/request IDs admit one operation; recovered observations cannot overwrite a newer completed result; concurrent recoveries record one immutable event and one agent-state revision.
criteria.remaining: The measured contract is SQLite-backed hosted-route logic; real multi-host process death and external side effects are not certified.

criteria.requirement: Crash/retry tests produce correct terminal states and auditable recovery.
criteria.observed: Expired leases requeue under budget, preserve prior results on exhaustion, persist an audit event, and roll back atomically if audit persistence fails; resumed queued work executes successfully.
criteria.remaining: Lease expiry is induced in SQLite; no physical Docker-host crash test is claimed.

criteria.requirement: Unsupported edits and stale baselines are rejected with recoverable errors.
criteria.observed: Traversal, changed baselines and credential-bearing candidates reject; saved-output recovery rejects stale/malformed/replayed candidates; source switch creates a fresh job preserving old evidence.
criteria.remaining: General language-aware refactoring and real AI generation are outside this bounded snapshot-validation proof.

criteria.requirement: Retry cannot silently duplicate or overwrite unrelated work.
criteria.observed: Repeated draft-PR request returns existing recorded result with no additional fixture HTTP writes; snapshot apply and rollback replay are rejected; switch requests reuse one job.
criteria.remaining: Concurrent external GitHub failures and provider-side branch reconciliation are not proven by stubbed HTTP.

criteria.requirement: Updates/deletes do not leave stale edges or reveal unauthorized nodes.
criteria.observed: Actual project deletion removes historical integration participants from graph; current labels replace stale snapshot names; emitted edges have valid endpoints. Project deletion and snapshot clearing remove their own nested audit artifacts; a second project and its audit children remain intact and the resulting backup validates.
criteria.remaining: Cross-tenant authorization is not supplied by this owner-private graph, and historical integration snapshots intentionally retain their content.

criteria.requirement: Known gaps are detected with actionable evidence and acceptable measured false-positive rates.
criteria.observed: Known SQL concatenation, tests/docs/accessibility gaps are detected; covered fixture produces no presence gaps; resumable traversal inspects 150 files and excludes secret payload fetches.
criteria.remaining: Measured false-positive evaluation across representative authorized projects remains unperformed.

criteria.requirement: Relevant historical evidence can be retrieved across project versions with provenance.
criteria.observed: Search returns stored evidence citations; decision revisions retain previous rationale and recorded outcomes.
criteria.remaining: Semantic retrieval and comprehensive cross-version source lineage remain incomplete.

criteria.requirement: Access, correction, retention and deletion are verified.
criteria.observed: Project deletion and decision correction execute; backups exclude credential settings; malformed restores leave the store unchanged. Project deletion and snapshot clearing remove their own nested audit artifacts; a second project and its audit children remain intact and the resulting backup validates.
criteria.remaining: Multi-user access policy and timed retention/deletion convergence remain unqualified.

criteria.requirement: A clean environment restores approved data and artifacts successfully.
criteria.observed: Complete records/jobs/source artifacts restore transactionally into a fresh SQLite store; exact record counts/content read back; restored jobs are canceled with no leases or credentials; duplicate restore has one winner. Project deletion and snapshot clearing remove their own nested audit artifacts; a second project and its audit children remain intact and the resulting backup validates.
criteria.remaining: Supported restore remains bounded to 498 records/jobs per transaction; deployed backups, external resources and recovery-time objectives are not certified.

criteria.requirement: Lost/rotated credentials fail safely and can be reauthorized.
criteria.observed: Missing and rotated AES-GCM vault keys fail before any outbound provider request; disconnect and save under the new key permits successful fixture reauthorization, without exposing secrets.
criteria.remaining: This tests API-provider credential recovery; live OAuth reauthorization and managed key-rotation operations remain unqualified.

criteria.requirement: Security review findings are recorded and fixed or explicitly dispositioned.
criteria.observed: Concrete credential-verification race, stale-graph state, malformed backup acceptance and loss of recovery evidence are recorded and repaired with before/after failures.
criteria.remaining: An independent audit of all credential and provider boundaries is not replaced by these focused repairs.

criteria.requirement: Tests exercise material failure paths and no secrets appear in logs/exports.
criteria.observed: OAuth replay/origin/redirect and metadata redaction negatives execute; provider verification race and key loss fail safely; backups exclude settings and raw fixture keys.
criteria.remaining: This is bounded fixture disclosure checking, not exhaustive live secret/log scanning.

criteria.requirement: Behavioral bugs and regressions cause meaningful failures.
criteria.observed: New behavior regressions produce 15 failing cases against the original implementations; all 21 cases pass after causal repairs. Tests exercise actual SQLite state, crypto and product code.
criteria.remaining: User project applications still require their own toolchain tests through a qualified isolated worker.

criteria.requirement: Passing snapshot-integrity checks is not presented as application correctness.
criteria.observed: Static/generated snapshot checks disclose runtime checks not run; execution assignments distinguish snapshot-integrity and node-application profiles and reject trivial application test declarations.
criteria.remaining: No snapshot-integrity pass is promoted here to general application or production certification.

criteria.requirement: An induced test-environment incident is detected, diagnosed, repaired, checked and safely rolled back on failure.
criteria.observed: A real local child process fails, supervisor restores previous release pointer and quarantines the failed release; observed file side effects confirm rollback.
criteria.remaining: This is the companion release supervisor; production diagnosis from target telemetry and staged code repair remain incomplete.

repairs.defect: Retry exhaustion replaced all prior candidate/review/test evidence and recovery had no durable audit event.
repairs.repair: Guarded atomic job recovery preserves result, changes agent status and appends one recovery event; stale observation and audit-storage failure cannot corrupt state.

repairs.defect: Integration snapshots resurrected deleted source nodes and stale names.
repairs.repair: Current stored project identity is required before emitting integration participants.

repairs.defect: Restore accepted non-project job targets, dangling record links, null/array payloads and invalid retry counts.
repairs.repair: Validate JSON object shapes and typed project/audit-child relationships before transaction; preserve valid repo_tree/repo_file parent model.

repairs.defect: Old provider verification could mark newly saved credentials ready; named verification returned legacy provider metadata.
repairs.repair: Compare-and-swap exact encrypted configuration and independent verification identity; return the selected provider status.

repairs.defect: Project deletion and snapshot clear removed audit parent rows but retained repo_tree/repo_file rows keyed to the audit ID, leaving orphan artifacts and invalid future backups.
repairs.repair: Delete only the selected project audit children before audit parents in the guarded transaction; a unique snapshot-clear identity prevents stale cleanup from following a failed update.

publicationPolicy: Do not auto-close parents or claim live provider/Docker certification from this report. Read original criterion plus remaining scope and bind the final source to the root verification run before any promotion.
